scope: Public controlled civilian laboratory datasets only; no operational/live emitter identification, no astronomy origin inference, no operational fingerprints or G4 mutation.

sources.name: INRIA
sources.description: Reported 2.4 GHz, 20 MS/s, complex64; device and capture layout must be independently inspected before selecting groups.

sources.name: WLAN
sources.description: Five ESP32, two environments; verify same frequency and device labels, capture units and sessions.

sources.name: WiSig
sources.description: Same configured network identifiers, random payloads, preambles, distinct days and receivers; avoid unsafe pickle loading.

sources.name: ROBUST-6G
sources.description: Thirty same-model civilian lab transmitters, 866MHz; official chronological splits and simultaneous captures. Metadata only.

qualification: Verify official record metadata and published checksum; inventory INRIA archive without extraction or reading IQ samples. No fitting or evaluation until exact independent capture IDs, same carrier configuration, transmitter labels and split eligibility are verified; report ambiguity. Dataset files are untrusted, do not execute or deserialize pickle.
identifiability: Demonstrate exact non-injectivity of power spectrum in fixed discrete toy signals: two distinct phase configurations can have identical magnitude spectra; all global phase rotations have identical STFT power. This is mathematical counterexample only, not measured different transmitters. Power-only inference must abstain when features insufficient.

future_exam.scope: Offline civilian controlled laboratory data, power-only vs shape-only baseline, held out receiver/day/session (or independent whole files), labels not features, device labels and protocol metadata held separate; score same/different balanced pairs without frequency shortcut. Report unknown/abstention, paired error and grouped uncertainty; no claims of telescope applicability without matched narrowband low-resolution measured observations.
future_exam.gate: No evaluation until qualified independent units. No deployment, suppression, label promotion, or release.
